idea-plugin.name: Ansibility
idea-plugin.description:
AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT DISCLAIMER: This plugin has been extensively developed with the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (LLMs). While rigorously designed, typed, and tested against real-world Ansible environments and specifications, please be aware of its AI-assisted origins and feel free to report any unexpected behavior or issues.

Ansibility makes Ansible feel truly native in PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, and IntelliJ IDEA.

Key Features:

  • Host Awareness & Context Switching: Full understanding of inventories, environments, group hierarchies, and group_vars/host_vars inheritance. Switch active host context via the status bar widget or quick actions.
  • Variable Precedence & Deep Inspection: Variable cards with interactive "Explain Precedence" view showing values across all inventory, playbook, and role layers.
  • Seamless Ansible Vault Integration: In-editor inline vault reveal/edit/encrypt/decrypt/rekey, whole-file vault tabs with safe synchronization protection, lock gutter icons, and structural envelope inspections.
  • Role Argument Specs & Strict Type Checking: JSDoc-like documentation from meta/argument_specs.yml, hover cards, auto-completion, and static type checking against ansible-core's type rules.
  • Jinja2 & YAML Language Injection: Full Jinja2 syntax support for *.j2 and automatic injection into YAML expressions (when:, changed_when:, templates) with smart variable, fact, and filter completion.
  • Live Template Split Preview: Preview rendered Jinja2 templates directly in a split editor for the active host/play context.
  • Module & Keyword Intelligence: Built-in documentation hover, auto-completion, and inspections for Ansible modules, options, and play/task keywords with direct links to official docs.
  • Navigation, Find Usages & Refactoring: Go to Definition (Ctrl+B), Find Usages (Alt+F7), Highlight Usages (Ctrl+Shift+F7), and safe renaming for variables and roles.
  • Ansible Tool Window & Workspace Scopes: Dedicated tool window for exploring environments, groups, hosts, playbooks, roles, effective variables table, and workspace scopes filtering.
